claim_text: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows through deterministic route-policy dispatch, GraphRAG context-pack grounding, and human override escalation paths.
Advanced enterprise AI platform adoption through CFO-aligned adoption motions, connecting workflow value to usage-based forecasting and reusable commercialization patterns.
Strengthened production reliability with audit-grade runtime observability for regulated AI workflows, supported by evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls.
Standardized the AI solution lifecycle with production-readiness gates across intake, execution, monitoring, and remediation, enabling more repeatable client deployments.
Built high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across AWS and Databricks Lakehouse data pipelines, vector services, and parallel decision workflows.
Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a focused operating model.
